So `mm.dgram.buf=0x502000000010`, `mm.dgram.len=9`, `props_start=9`, `props_size=0`. This means `i = dgram.buf + props_start + ofs = 0x502000000010 + 9 + 0 = 0x502000000019`. Reading `i[0]` should trigger ASAN because the buffer is 9 bytes (0x502000000010 to 0x502000000019).

But ASAN is not triggered. This is very strange.
